early_point: After existing ADC/live_time/stable/loss/argument checks, before RX/prepare
post_IRQ_barrier: Fresh live_time and stable/loss before RX
fallback: Exact previous wrapper grant body only when early point not reached
actor: existing app scope remains entered; no reentrant FG/core callback from ISR
performance_limit: For a transfer not yet published at tud_task, early6/<500us window ages during RX/encode/TX; no second reset or startup throughput guarantee.
